description: 국가철도공단_대구1호선_역정보_역번호 정보 [railways and stations] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 국가철도공단. 역번호는 1983년 서울 지하철 2호선 서울대입구~을지로입구 구간이 개통될 때 세계 최초로 부여되기 시작했다. 그러나 아는 사람만 써먹는 등 활용은 잘 하지 않고 있다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 국가철도공단. Its tags are 도시광역철도, 역명, 대구지하철1호선, 노선명, 역번호. It offers 1 resource(s) in xlsx. The portal shows 2025-11-14 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
